S:7.5”
Being the underdog that
wins is not normal.
MINI JOHN COOPER WORKS In the course of a career that SPECIFICATIONS
revolutionized racing, John Cooper, the British racing legend,
j John Cooper Works available on all models
collected three Monte Carlo Rally titles and 16 Grand Prix wins. (Paceman available March 2013)
A fitting tribute to a racing icon, the MINI John Cooper Works
j Red Brembo® 4-piston front brake calipers with 12.4-inch
offers a potent combination of balanced handling and ballistic
ventilated brake discs (most models)
acceleration. The MINI John Cooper Works is tuned to achieve
j Tuned turbocharged, intercooled and direct-injected 208 HP
performance normally reserved for racecars, which, not
aluminum alloy engine with 192 lb-ft of torque
coincidentally, is exactly what it is.
j
Sport-tuned exhaust with dual stainless steel tips
j
Dynamic Traction Control with Electronic Differential Lock Control
j
Performance-tuned transmission
j
Optional 6-speed Aisin automatic transmission
0–60 MPH in 6.2 seconds (Hardtop), 6.6 seconds (Convertible),
j
6.5 seconds (Clubman), 6.1 seconds (Coupe), 6.3 seconds (Roadster)
and 6.6 seconds (Countryman)
All figures above relate to vehicles with the j 17" Challenge Spoke light-alloy wheels
standard 6-speed manual transmission. 18" Twin Spoke Black Burnished light-alloy wheels (Countryman only)
